observedDifference.evidence: qa-baseline has one cold run. Its first crop and the postfix cold crop run alone at [1,3,48,234]. The same prepared crop in postfix warm runs with a second region at [2,3,48,256]. coldFirstSerial changes true to false. A confidence exactness assertion across these different actual OCR input shapes is not a valid same-input comparison; the observed difference is retained rather than normalized away.
observedDifference.downstreamReadOnlyAudit: Paddle accepts confidence >=0.2; both values are accepted. mapResultsToRegions stores it as region.prob. Textline merge uses probability only to aggregate weighted geometric probability, not to decide which lines merge. OCR postfilter can use aggregated probability; both main runs report no-candidates (candidateCount=0, filteredCount=0). Full ordered records and final pixels remain exact for this sample.

limits: GPU tests are local original-text typesetting, not remote translation correctness tests. CPU tests cover one main fixture per browser version.

The performance run measures one cold and one warm pipeline only and is kept separate from prior benchmark matrices.

The warm main GPU OCR confidence differs for one region because the recorded actual OCR batch/input width differs from the cold-only reference. OCR texts, coordinates and order are exact, but the complete OCR records cannot be called identical across those two different input shapes.
